svg.title: What the startup architecture trials established
svg.desc: The trial compared check and badge outcomes separately from which instruction files were actually reread. Candidate check passes occurred with a patched checker, while no cards were opened.
svg.text: A check can pass while recovery fails
Four session trials · two current-route controls · two scratch candidates · one forced compact each
Both post-break checks passed; shipped checker.
DIRECTOR complete in both; START re-attached only.
OPERATIONS partial in one, complete in one.
One initial greeting: permission denied, no badge; passed after compact.
Both post-break checks passed; patched copy.
Zero cards opened in both; recovery missed.
Both initial greetings passed only with patched checker.
No post-break staffing; actual writes were denied.
Badge survival is narrow evidence; it does not prove card re-entry, held-work recovery or whole-method continuity.
